gen_transitions: create a bigram transition graph for a linear-chain CRF with a given number of classes
gen_potentials: build a unary potential graph for a CRF with specified features and output classes
gen_model: generate a CRF model with random arc weights for potentials and transitions graphs
make_chain_graph: create a simple chain graph from an iterable sequence of integer labels
crf_loss: compute the negative log-likelihood loss for a linear-chain CRF given input and target sequences
